title: Embeddings and isomorphisms of extensions of a field
statement: Let $F$ be a field and $E/F$, $E'/F$ two field extensions [def-pc-field-extension], with structure homomorphisms $\iota:F\to E$ and $\iota':F\to E'$. An *$F$-embedding* (a morphism of extensions of $F$) $\sigma:E\to E'$ is a ring homomorphism with $\sigma\circ\iota=\iota'$, that is, an $F$-algebra homomorphism; it is injective, since a ring homomorphism between fields is. An *$F$-isomorphism* $E\xrightarrow{\sim}E'$ is a bijective $F$-embedding; its inverse is an $F$-embedding. For $F=\mathbf Q$ and fields of characteristic $0$ (extensions of $\mathbf Q$ through their prime subfields [def-weil-algebraic-element]) every ring homomorphism is a $\mathbf Q$-embedding, since it fixes $1$ and therefore every rational number.
